entries.original_title: Alibaba Model Studio newly released models updated
entries.subtitle: Alibaba Model Studio added PixVerse video-generation models with support for 15-second videos, synchronized audio and video, and multilingual text.
entries.reject_reason: The page change lists third-party models on Alibaba Model Studio rather than announcing a new Qwen model or major Alibaba product launch.

entries.original_title: Paper page - SpatialScout: Can VLM Agents Actively Explore and Map 3D Scenes?
entries.subtitle: SpatialScout tests vision-language agents on 3D mapping across 80 indoor scenes with 3,140 objects, and finds gaps in map accuracy.
entries.reject_reason: SpatialScout is research by an untracked university team; its appearance on a tracked paper site and evaluation of tracked models do not make it their research.

entries.original_title: Mistral Advances AI for Engineering with NVIDIA
entries.subtitle: Mistral and NVIDIA are combining AI models, accelerated computing, and physics tools to build engineering workflows for simulations and design.
entries.reject_reason: Mistral and NVIDIA describe planned engineering integrations and benchmarks, but no benchmark result or product has launched.

entries.original_title: How Companies Are Using NVIDIA DSX to Break the Power Bottleneck
entries.subtitle: NVIDIA DSX links power grids and AI facilities so companies can plan and manage power needs as one system.
entries.reject_reason: The article highlights partner adoption and applications of the existing NVIDIA DSX platform rather than a new launch.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Cache Engineering for Agents
entries.subtitle: AKV manages language-model agent caches without changing task histories, aiming to reduce storage work while preserving accuracy.
entries.reject_reason: The cache-engineering paper is from an untracked research team, and a tracker’s paper page does not make the work its own.

entries.original_title: Paper page - PrismaCoder: Pushing the Boundaries of Open Multimodal Code Intelligence through Decomposed Rubric Synthesis
entries.subtitle: The research presents a rubric-based process to create and filter multimodal code data, supporting open models for visual coding tasks.
entries.reject_reason: PrismaCoder is work from an untracked university group, not research attributable to the tracked paper site.

entries.original_title: Paper page - StreamEval: Evaluating Interactive Streaming Video Generation Models
entries.subtitle: StreamEval tests 37 models across 300 cases and finds that reliable request handling and consistent video states remain difficult.
entries.reject_reason: StreamEval is not presented as research from a tracked entity, despite appearing on a tracked paper site.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Socratic Skill Learning: Interleaving Teaching and Practice for Transferable Agent Skills
entries.subtitle: Socratic Skill Learning combines expert teaching with practice and review to help agents reuse skills on new tasks.
entries.reject_reason: Socratic Skill Learning is attributed to an untracked lab, and listing it on a tracked paper site is insufficient.

entries.original_title: Paper page - DONIC: Generalist Dexterous Bimanual Tracking Control from Human Demonstrations
entries.subtitle: DONIC learns two-handed robot movements from human demonstrations and reports strong results on unfamiliar objects without fine-tuning.
entries.reject_reason: DONIC is research by an untracked team rather than a development from the tracked paper site.

entries.original_title: Leading European Financial Services Organizations Embrace Open Models to Build Proprietary Intelligence
entries.subtitle: European finance companies are using open models and NVIDIA computing to build AI systems for their own operations and customers.
entries.reject_reason: This NVIDIA article primarily surveys financial-services deployments of existing technology rather than announcing NVIDIA research or a launch.

entries.original_title: Paper page - Spectral-Spatial Interpretation
entries.subtitle: Spectral-Spatial Interpretation measures which image channels matter at each location, offering detailed explanations for multispectral image models.
entries.reject_reason: The attribution-method paper is not shown to come from a tracked research entity.

entries.original_title: NVIDIA Open Models Power a New Wave of European Public Sector Projects
entries.subtitle: European public agencies are using open models that let them control infrastructure, protect sensitive data, and adapt services to local needs.
entries.reject_reason: The public-sector article chiefly describes partner projects and uses of existing NVIDIA models and tools.

entries.original_title: Patch the Planet: global response coordination as agents uncover critical vulnerabilities
entries.subtitle: Patch the Planet links security researchers, maintainers, and incident responders to help address serious flaws in open-source software.
entries.reject_reason: Patch the Planet is described as a security-coordination initiative, not a research result or a launched product.

entries.original_title: NVIDIA Transforms European Retail, From Digital Discovery to Physical Operations
entries.subtitle: European retailers are using NVIDIA tools and open models, with Shopify reporting 90% lower serving costs and responses 7x faster.
entries.reject_reason: This is a roundup of retailers’ deployments and fine-tuning on NVIDIA technology, not a new NVIDIA model or product launch.

entries.original_title: How Specializing the Vocabulary of SLMs Can Cut Inference Cost by 77% in Real Applications

entries.original_title: How we built ChatGPT’s novel ad stack for user trust and relevance

entries.reject_reason: This is an engineering explanation of OpenAI’s existing ad stack rather than a new technique with reported research results or a launch.
